shortDescription: Adds, removes or updates a Windows PowerShell repository.

options.name: force
options.description: If C(True), any differences from the desired state will result in the repository being unregistered, and then re-registered. I(force) has no effect when I(state=absent). See notes for additional context.

options.name: installation_policy
options.description: Sets the C(InstallationPolicy) of a repository. Will default to C(trusted) when creating a new repository or used with I(force=True).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the repository to work with.

options.name: password
options.description: Password to authenticate against private repository.

options.name: publish_location
options.description: Specifies the URI for publishing modules to this repository.

options.name: script_publish_location
options.description: Specifies the URI for publishing scripts to this repository.

options.name: script_source_location
options.description: Specifies the URI for discovering and installing scripts from this repository.

options.name: source_location
options.description: Specifies the URI for discovering and installing modules from this repository. A URI can be a NuGet server feed (most common situation), HTTP, HTTPS, FTP or file location. Required when registering a new repository or using I(force=True).

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present) a new repository is added or updated. If C(absent) a repository is removed.

options.name: username
options.description: Username to authenticate against private repository.
